morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics faces export contraction and fuel cost hikes despite container freight relief.
what_changed: Iran war disruptions caused a Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports over six months.
Propane usage resumed in the cluster, but prices rose by Rs 3/kg to reach Rs 104/kg.
Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent, offering shipping cost relief.
stress_signals: Ceramic exports plummeted by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the war in Iran [19f71f3185bc].
Industrial propane gas prices increased by Rs 3/kg to Rs 104/kg, raising production cost pressures [9e8c549b7c05], [3d9aa30057b8].
Tile industry faces broader export market challenges alongside rising overall cost pressures [895aa138960b].
improvement_signals: Container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for Morbi ceramics exporters [d6c30857de2c].
what_to_watch: Further escalations in industrial propane prices above Rs 104/kg and fuel cost impact on unit margins.
Export order book recovery and receivables turnover for units trading with Middle East destinations.
Working capital utilization spikes among export-oriented tile and sanitaryware manufacturers.

surat.headline: Divergence in Surat: Textile payment stress vs recovery signals in diamonds and policy incentives.
what_changed: Sayan weaving cluster planned a collective 15-day vacation to cut production by 60 crore meters amid financial distress.
Diamond processing units report demand revival and early post-vacation reopening, though constrained by rough supply.
Textile segment faces escalating payment defaults, payment blockages, and trade fraud, prompting industry bodies to seek legal intervention.
Labor disputes in the embroidery sub-segment were resolved, while MedTech testing launched via MANTRA.
stress_signals: Surat Mercantile Association warns of a severe payment crisis threatening small traders across the textile value chain [id e0787797133b].

Multiple payment default and fraud cases reported: ₹1.5 crore defaulted to 10 jobworkers [id 6a3068dc8bf1], ₹22 lakh fraud by Ahmedabad traders [id f699b1f05b5e], and widespread organized buyer defaults prompting SGCCI to demand GUJCTOC application [id 421d4bf835f5].

Diamond sector context shows structural stress with reports of 100,000 job losses during the recent downturn [id 1bcd949a2599] and pre-Diwali closures driven by rough diamond shortages [id b65b93c4b724].
Tragic incident involving a diamond merchant suicide due to financial distress [id 9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Government policy tailwinds: Surat Textile Policy cleared 627 units representing ₹1,521 crore investment [id 021c037e28d9], while Textile PLI turnover thresholds were halved and extended to FY34 [id c7ee55f3effe].

Surat diamond units staying operational until Dhanteras and planning early post-festive reopening on improving global demand [id e533595d0815, bd78e4a130ff], with Lab-Grown Diamond (LGD) units offering 10% worker bonuses [id 751cd1661531].
Embroidery labor agreement reached [id 3a495ae0b3ee] and export MoUs signed in Morocco by SGCCI [id 472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Working capital cycle and trade credit extended by Sayan weaving and job-work units following the 60M meter production cut.
Overdue receivables and cash flow adequacy of micro/small textile traders affected by inter-state buyer payment blockages.
Rough diamond inventory levels and import flows post-Diwali to ensure cutting units resume full capacity.
Rundown of festive inventory in value-added saree segments (e.g., Fanti Satin) to gauge post-Diwali cash realization.
